summary: Apple-inspired research dashboard and public landing portal for the Advanced Nanomedicine & Biosafety Laboratory, featuring interactive data tools and publications bibliography search.

portal_pages.Home: Overview of lab, announcement bars, research highlights.
portal_pages.About: Academic timeline, background, and PI profiles.
portal_pages.Publications: Database-driven bibliography with search, filtering, and page navigation.
portal_pages.Research & Team: Lab projects descriptions and personnel rosters.

webtools_dashboard.layout: WebToolsLayout with sticky navigation and responsive mobile side-drawer.

tools.NeuroBioAxis: Search portal for Tool 1 (nanoparticle interactions in neurological systems).
tools.PolyToxMap: Filter/search interface for Tool 2 (polymer-based toxicity data).
tools.PolyToxPredictor: Interactive playground for machine learning toxicity simulation.
tools.MaterialDetails: Exportable PDF-styled report displaying physiochemical parameters, in vitro, in vivo, safety recovery stats, and reference articles.

recent_updates: Created WebTools platform dashboard layout with responsive sidebar navigation.
Built PolyToxMapSearch with customizable range sliders and data tables.
Designed MaterialDetails component supporting multi-section scientific reports (1.0 - 5.0) and PDF export triggers.
Added an offline detector screen blocking queries and prompting for reconnection when offline.

development_notes.api_connection: Proxied to backend on http://localhost:5000. Production builds can modify fetch base parameters in components.
development_notes.animations: Page transition animations are handled via the .fade-in utility class inside index.css.
